description: List the unfinished tasks due today or overdue (up to 50) that would move to a new due date, and return a short-lived preview token. Undated and future tasks are not included. Changes nothing. Show the list to the user and get a clear yes before calling apply_task_move.

to_date.description: New due date. Must be today or later and at most 365 days ahead.

name: preview_task_move
title: Preview moving unfinished tasks
